record.bible_text: Concerning the Ammonites<WH01121><WH05983>, thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Hath Israel<WH03478> no sons<WH01121>? hath he no heir<WH03423><WTH8802>? why <FI>then<Fi> doth their king<WH04428> inherit<WH03423><WTH8804> Gad<WH01410>, and his people<WH05971> dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in his cities<WH05892>? <RF>Concerning: or, Against<Rf> <RF>their king: or, Melcom<Rf>
